_about: Voiceover for launch videos. Each line: id, start (s), max (latest end, s), text as the voice should read it (spell out numbers and acronyms: 'two a.m.', 'Abacus A.I.'). A {"ref": id} reuses a line from another track, so shared lines are generated once. 'voice' configures generation (see scripts/vo_gen.py); 'mix' configures ducking and music automation (see scripts/mix.py). Optional 'must' lists words vo_check.py must hear exactly (use it for the product name).
